test_transformerxl_param_count: test the TransformerXL model to verify its parameter count matches expected values for a given vocab size
test_transformerxl_with_extra_embeddings: test the TransformerXL model with extra embeddings and masks for conditioned language modeling
test_graph_embedding_model: test the GraphEmbeddingModel to verify it produces correct node and edge embedding shapes from a Jraph graph
test_unpack_and_pad: test the unpack_and_pad utility to verify it correctly segments and pads batched sequences with masks
test_graph2text_transformer_learns: test the Graph2TextTransformer end-to-end training loop to verify the model learns and loss decreases below threshold
